text:
Elaine A.: NeonBridge wants a quick POC for their custom model variant llama70b-neo-v2-quant. They asked about hosting options, KMS/HSM, tokenization, and a ballpark for reserved + burst. Need an estimate for 80–120 qps, 4k context. 
Ravi (SE): We can ingest their variant but need to verify rmsnorm/rope compatibility. Our q4 execution path typically works but we should run an automatic compat scan. Expect ~24–36h for full validation; quick perf sweep tonight possible. 
James I.: Dedicated ok for POC; if they require HSM-backed keys or strict VPC isolation we'll need Private. Private also requires platform license for enterprise. 
NeonBridge-POC: We do require HSM for key wrapping and SOC2 compliance. Also note we trained with a custom tokenizer and have a modified embedding head. 
Lina S. (Security): HSM + SOC2: Private deployment required. Please provide model provenance, weights checksum, and tokenization details. Also complete the security questionnaire section on key lifecycle. 
Ravi (SE): Custom tokenizer: ask them to upload the tokenizer files and a couple sample prompts. If tokenizer is nonstandard we can add a small adapter, usually adds ~40–80ms on p50 for generation. 
Elaine A.: Timeline: demo slot in 9 days. Sales needs ballpark pricing today to draft SOW. Can we give a conservative number for reserved capacity + burst + Private license? 
James I.: Rough numbers: Dedicated reserved baseline for 70b quant variant: ~$16k/month. Burst reserve for 100 qps: +$5k/month. Private one-time platform/license: $60k (range 50–85k) + infra run rate depending on region. HSM adds recurring infra cost. 
Ravi (SE): Memory note: KV cache for 4k context with 4-bit quant: approx 16–22GB per concurrent stream worst-case. If they need many concurrent streams we should use batching and prefix caching. 
NeonBridge-POC: 16–22GB per stream is high. Can we compromise with chunking + TTL tweaks? 
Ravi (SE): Yes. Two strategies: prefix caching for repeated system prompts, or split context and stream with partial caches. Recommend kv_ttl 20–45s for POC. Example config: 
``` 
model_variant: llama70b-neo-v2-q4
enable_kv_cache: true
kv_ttl_sec: 30
batch_config:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  max_wait_ms: 12
``` 
Lina S. (Security): I'll email the checklist: SOC attestation, HSM/KMS requirements, model checksums, retention policy, and network diagram for Private. Expect in ~1.5 hours. 
James I.: I'll run a quick capacity calc and spin up a staging perf job tonight; deploy-bot will post results. p99 latency and throughput by EOD. 
Elaine A.: Actions: @NeonBridge-POC share model bundle + tokenizer + SFDC opp id; @Ravi queue ingest & quick eval; @James run capacity & perf; @Lina send security checklist. I'll update the customer after perf numbers. Thanks! :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Perf job queued: neonbridge-staging-70b-quant-sweep (#9801) — ETA 40m. 
NeonBridge-POC: uploading model bundle to S3 now and popping the link in DM. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
